turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here? Owen's zero went in before anyone called me.
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
Look at it how? You haven't told me what you have.
You're very sharp, you know that?
I'm not here to be complimented. What do you have on the essay?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't said a word about a timestamp. What timestamp, Hale?
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
Flattery isn't a document. You still haven't answered me about the timestamp, so show me what you have.
